role: Senior Full Stack Developer → Director, Engineering
title: PolicyStreet — Insurance Comparison Platform
summary: Internal teams and partners needed consistent quoting and issuance across different insurers.
result: Connected insurer quotations and policy issuance for internal teams and partners.
details: Problem
Unify provider quotation and issuance flows across motor, medical, group medical and fire insurance.
Ownership
Built backend and frontend rate-fetching and normalization as a Senior Full Stack Developer, then led development and operations as Engineering Director.
Key Engineering Decision

Designed an event-driven quotation architecture using Node.js. Introduced quotation caching and pre-warmed data to reduce repeated processing and support faster quotations, including potential renewals for existing customers.
Business rules

Quotations expire after seven days. Changes to customer information that affect quotation terms require quotation revision. Caching and pre-warming do not exempt quotations from these validity requirements.
Constraints & approach

Integrated insurer APIs and internal services under changing business and regulatory requirements. Applied security and consistency checks; modernised legacy code for clarity and integration stability.
Delivered Capability
Supported fast quotation workflows with rate normalization and integrated issuance for internal teams and partners, while accommodating expiry and changes affecting quotations.

title: WenSymes — Human Resources Management Platform
summary: Adaptable HR and administration workflows, with full-stack web development, Google Cloud and Microsoft 365.
result: Contributed adaptable internal tools; professional collaboration continues on an occasional basis.
details: Business problem
Internal HR and operational administration needed to accommodate changing employee roles and organizational needs.
Role & ownership
Principal Full Stack Developer experience building internal administration tools and planning product-domain capabilities. The engagement continues as occasional professional collaboration.
Key Engineering Decision
Prioritized system flexibility so changing employee roles and responsibilities could be accommodated as organizational headcount and operational needs evolved.
Constraints & planning

Organizational flexibility must account for clear responsibilities and appropriate access to HR information. Planning considers data consistency, access control and uptime; detailed internal rules and implementation remain private.
Delivered Capability
Supported an adaptable approach to organizational roles and HR workflows without assuming that responsibilities would remain fixed.
Technical approach
Full-stack web development with Google Cloud and Microsoft 365.

title: Enterprise Education Systems — Modernization & Technical Consulting
summary: Stakeholder-informed workflows across established and modernized education and administrative systems.
result: Helped align operational workflows with user responsibilities while supporting continued platform use and modernisation.
details: Business problem
Established education and administrative systems needed workflows shaped around actual operational processes and responsibilities.
My contribution
Led full-stack development and contributed technical direction as Principal Full Stack Engineer.
Key Engineering Decision
Engaged stakeholders to understand existing operational processes, identify workflow requirements and design suitable workflows across established and modernized systems.
Verified workflow examples
Online class activity tracking, HRMS document-expiration tracking and other stakeholder-informed operational workflows.
Constraints & priorities

Modernise established software while supporting its ongoing use and development. Maintainability, dependable delivery and long-term platform development remain priorities. Internal product identities and implementation details remain private.
Delivered Capability
Helped shape structured workflows aligned with actual user and stakeholder responsibilities, while supporting continued operation and modernization of existing systems.

role: Freelance Principal Full Stack Solution Developer
title: Rental operations, from contracts to financial clarity.
summary: Web-based rental operations for staff working in the office and on the move.
result: Made key rental-management functions accessible from compatible mobile and desktop browsers.
details: Problem
Staff needed to manage contracts, renewals, cancellations and financial visibility across more than 20 rental properties, including operational work outside the office.
Ownership
Designed and implemented the business subletting and home rental management system as a freelance Principal Full Stack Solution Developer.
Key Engineering Decision
Designed and developed a mobile-friendly, web-based rental management system to support operational work outside the office.
Domain design
Separated property, tenant and contract records to support multi-entity workflows, contract generation and payment tracking.
Operating constraints
Access described here is internet-connected through compatible mobile or desktop browsers.
Delivered Capability

Enabled access to property, tenant and rental records; supported rental contract renewals and sending contract PDFs directly from mobile devices. Staff could review rental and financial reports remotely, including property-level income, expenses and profit/loss. Supported rental operations involving more than 20 properties.
